one_month_reasoning: The window (to 2026-11-01) very likely contains Q3 2026 results: last year's Q3 came out on Oct 29 and data providers list Oct 28-29, 2026 (consensus about $1.89). Q2 had a big beat ($1.90 adjusted vs about $1.52 expected) helped by $2-3M of one-time gains, and guidance was raised to $6.80-7.20, which implies about $3.7 for H2. Backlog is at a record (+30% YoY), so I expect a solid print and probably a nudge toward the top of the range. But the stock has already gained 16% in two sessions (Oct 1-2, $269.59 to $312.16, on rising volume, around a Jefferies Buy initiation with a $314 target) and 31% since early September. It sits at the old 52-week high and at the sell-side target cluster ($300-330), so short-term reversal risk offsets the positive earnings drift. Also, Q2's 23.3% margin had one-time help, so Q3 margins may compare poorly. Net: median a touch below spot (~$309), with lognormal spread sigma about 16.5% (a bit under the 59%/3.5 rule of thumb's 17%), keeping the earnings-day jump risk.

fair_value.method: Blend of P/E (2028E adj EPS $9.60 x 29x = $278), EV/EBITDA (2028E adj EBITDA $350M x 18x less ~$350M net debt = $281) and a FCF DCF (9.5% WACC, ~$179 rolled forward) weighted 45/35/20, giving ~$260 for Oct 2027. That is below the $312 spot because the stock already prices ~37x 2027E EPS.

inputs_detail.derivation: Backlog +30% YoY and H1 orders +30% YoY, plus defense RFQs >$500M against $90M of H1 defense orders, support low-double-digit value-added sales growth. Add margin moving to the 23% mid-term target and roughly flat share count (21.1M diluted). Haircut versus 2026's +30% because Q2 had $2-3M one-offs and 2026 benefited from a recovery off the precision-clad trough.
Growth fades to ~15.5% as the backlog conversion normalizes. This is the NTM EPS the market will capitalize in Oct 2027.

Today the stock trades at ~44.6x 2026 guidance midpoint and ~37.6x my 2027E. Sell-side targets average about $301 and Jefferies is at $314 (~38x 2027E). I assume partial multiple compression as growth slows from 30% to the mid-teens. 29x still prices a scarcity premium (sole Western integrated beryllium supplier) over the ~20x of a specialty-materials compounder.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: 2028E adj EBITDA $350M x 18x = $6.30B EV, less ~$350M net debt (Oct 2027) = $5.95B over 21.2M shares

inputs_detail.derivation: VA sales: 2026E ~$1.18B (H1 $570M, +8%, with H2 accelerating on backlog), then ~+11%/yr to ~$1.46B in 2028. Margin of 24% assumes the 23% mid-term target is exceeded modestly.
LT debt $423.2M + ST debt $17.5M + finance lease $12.7M - cash $20.0M = $433M. Reduced by FCF after the ~$12M/yr dividend; capex guided ~$100M for 2026.
Current EV ≈ $6.58B market cap + $0.43B net debt ≈ $7.0B, about 26x 2026E EBITDA (~$266M) and 22.6x my 2027E (~$310M). I assume some compression as growth decelerates.

methods.name: DCF
methods.inputs: FCF $110M in 2026, growing 22% for 3 years then 15%, terminal growth 4%, WACC 9.5%, less $433M net debt over 21.2M shares = $164 today, rolled forward one year at 9.5% = ~$179

inputs_detail.derivation: Management targets ~75% FCF conversion on adj net income of ~$147M ($7.00 x 21.1M). H1 FCF was $39M ($70.5M CFO - $31.5M capex/mine development).
High-beta small/mid-cap with 59% realized volatility and modest leverage (~1.6x EBITDA). Terminal growth of 4% reflects secular semi, defense and space demand.

bear.story: Q3/Q4 margins fall back from the one-off-aided 23.3%, and the precision-clad customer issue or a semis/AI capex pause stalls Electronic Materials. Initial 2027 guidance in late January lands around +10%, and the multiple compresses to ~24x 2027E (~$7.9) as the momentum crowd exits. Price ~$190, back to pre-Q2 levels.

base.story: Mid-teens EPS growth continues (2027E ~$8.30, 2028E ~$9.60) on defense, space and semis backlog. Margins hold at about the 23% target. The multiple compresses from ~45x trailing guidance to ~31-32x NTM, so price roughly flat at ~$305.

bull.story: Defense RFQs (>$500M open) convert, beryllium scarcity and critical-mineral policy support a premium multiple, and 2027 guidance is $8.75+ with EBITDA margin >24%. The market keeps ~38-40x NTM EPS of ~$10.5-11. Price ~$420.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$185 (about -40%) the stock would be back under its pre-Q2-print level (~$227) and at ~22x my 2027E EPS. That would most likely mean the growth story broke rather than ordinary volatility: a guidance cut, a backlog decline, loss or permanent reduction of the large precision-clad customer, or margin falling back toward 20%. Ordinary multiple de-rating alone should hold in the $220-260 range.

Recovery of the large precision-clad strip (consumer electronics) customer; H1 Performance Materials EBITDA was down 12% YoY with $3.5M of extra costs
Duration of the AI/semiconductor upcycle driving Electronic Materials (semis ~50% of net sales, mostly pass-through metal)
Conversion of the defense RFQ pipeline and timing of the $65M beryllium capacity expansion

reasoning: Primary documents: the Q2 2026 8-K showed record VA sales of $308.2M (+15%), adj EBITDA of $71.8M (23.3%), adj EPS of $1.90 and Q2 FCF of $59M, with guidance raised to $6.80-7.20 (+30% vs 2025's $5.44). The 10-Q adds what the recaps skip. H1 Performance Materials EBITDA fell 12% on the precision-clad 'controlled production ramp' ($3.5M extra costs, customer reimbursements for substitute material). Electronic Materials net sales of +67% are mostly pass-through metal ($94.6M of the increase), while its VA sales grew 15%. Remaining performance obligations jumped from $21.9M to $116.4M. Capex is guided ~$100M. There was no buyback in 2026 under the $50M authorization. The Q2 call cited $2-3M one-offs, defense orders of $90M with >$500M RFQs, and 2027 guidance coming around January. The EDGAR index shows a cluster of Form 144s and Form 4s Aug-Sep 2026 (insider selling into strength). Valuation: at $312 the stock is ~45x 2026 guidance midpoint and ~37.6x my 2027E $8.30. Blended fair value is ~$260 (P/E $278, EV/EBITDA $281, DCF $179). The latest move (+16% on Oct 1-2, around a Jefferies Buy/$314 initiation) puts price at or above most sell-side targets (avg ~$301). Distribution: a three-component lognormal mixture. Bear: 25% weight, median $190, sigma 0.40. Base: 50%, median $305, sigma 0.32. Bull: 25%, median $420, sigma 0.30. Overall median ~$302 and mean ~$322, implying ~59% realized-vol-like dispersion with fat tails. A slight negative median drift versus spot reflects valuation stretch and short-term overextension. Positive mean and upper tail reflect strong fundamental momentum and estimate revisions. Research limits: the Alpha Vantage transcript tool was rate-limited and Twelve Data estimates/targets were plan-restricted, so I used an investing.com transcript summary and web-reported targets. I did not identify a company-specific filing driving the Oct 1-2 jump.
